description: This file defines an interface INotesRepository for note persistence and retrieval operations within the NotesBackend project. It specifies methods for CRUD operations on Note objects.

methods.name: GetAll
methods.description: Retrieves all notes as an IEnumerable of Note objects.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Retrieves a Note by its Guid identifier. Returns null if not found.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new Note based on the provided Note object and returns the created Note.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates an existing Note and returns the updated Note, or null if the note was not found.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a Note identified by its Guid id. Returns true if successful, false otherwise.
